title: One author edits the same memory from two stale copies
preconditions: A is the author of a note and has it open on two devices.

actions.note: A creates the shared space.
B joins, so both members are active.
A creates a note.
The first device saves an edit.
The second device saves from the stale copy.
A reloads the archive.

expected_behavior: The stale write is rejected rather than silently overwriting the first edit.

candidate_failure_modes: A's stale save overwrites B without a warning.
The conflict is presented as a network error and the draft is lost.
Both edits are stored as duplicate memories.
